question: Are countries with higher long gdp per capita likely to have higher positive effect over years? Comparing the data to evaluate
query: SELECT AVG(log_GDP_per_capital) AS avg_log_gdp,         AVG(positive_affect) AS avg_positive_effect, FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY year ORDER BY log_GDP_per_capital DESC;  Note: This query compares the average GDP per capita with positive affect over different years. You may want to adjust it based on your specific requirements and data characteristics (e.g., filtering by a time range, adjusting grouping or ordering criteria).
